# ConsolationClient

`premake5.lua`, `generate.bat`, `generate-linux.sh`, `src/`, and `src_xlive/` define the Windows x86 Consolation Client build, runtime DLLs, offline LIVE shim, and game integration for *007: Quantum of Solace* multiplayer.

## Contents

- [Directory.Build.props](./Directory.Build.props) configures `ClCompile` include paths and warning disables.
- [premake5.lua](./premake5.lua) defines Premake projects, dependency loading, Git version generation, and build options.
- [generate.bat](./generate.bat) synchronizes submodules, verifies or downloads Premake `v5.0.0-beta8`, and generates `build\consolation-client.sln`.
- [generate-nightly.bat](./generate-nightly.bat) forwards `%*` to `generate.bat`.
- [generate-linux.sh](./generate-linux.sh) bootstraps Wine, MSVC-Wine, Premake, and x86 MSBuild before compiling the solution.
- [fixdeps.sh](./fixdeps.sh) reconstructs Git submodules from `.gitmodules`.
- [README.md](./README.md) documents supported game version `1.1`, installation, launch, nightly builds, and project credits.
- [LICENSE](./LICENSE) defines CC BY-NC 4.0 restrictions for ujicos’s 2026 work.

## Subdirectories

- [.agents-reverse-engineer/](./.agents-reverse-engineer/) contains `config.yaml` and `GENERATION-PLAN.md` for documentation generation.
- [required_files/](./required_files/) contains [README.txt](./required_files/README.txt) with Patch 1.1 and `Launch Consolation.lnk` requirements.
- [src/](./src/) contains `DllMain()`, `main()`, proxy-library forwarding, component loading, game bindings, exceptions, and utilities.
- [src_xlive/](./src_xlive/) contains `xlive_shim.cpp`, `xlive.def`, and offline Windows LIVE compatibility behavior.

## Build and Architecture

`premake5.lua` creates the `consolation-client` workspace with `d3d9` and `xlive` shared-library projects targeting x86/Win32, C++20, `v143`, and the latest Windows SDK.

`d3d9` compiles `src/**` with `std_include.hpp` precompiled headers, while `xlive` compiles `src_xlive/**` and exports the ABI defined by `xlive.def`.

`generate-buildinfo` derives `GIT_DESCRIBE`, `GIT_HASH`, `GIT_BRANCH`, `VERSION_PRODUCT`, `VERSION_BUILD`, and related values into `src/version.h`, `src/version.hpp`, and `version.txt`.

`dependencies.load()`, `dependencies.imports()`, and `dependencies.projects()` load dependency scripts under `./deps/premake/*.lua`, attach imports to `d3d9`, and add dependency projects.

`main()` validates the multiplayer installation, invokes `component_loader::post_start()` and `component_loader::post_load()`, and initializes runtime components under `src/component/`.

## Configuration and Workflow

`generate.bat` selects `PREMAKE_BIN` by preferring global `premake5.exe`, then hash-verified `tools\premake5.exe`, then the pinned `PREMAKE_URL`.

`generate-linux.sh` accepts `--yes`, `--clean`, `--no-deps`, `--no-submodules`, `--force`, `--verbose`, directory overrides, timeout overrides, and `debug|Debug` or `release|Release`.

`generate-linux.sh` runs `sync_submodules`, `gen_vscode`, `gen_bbuild`, `compile`, and `print_summary` on the fast path, with `compile()` targeting `build/consolation-client.sln` and `Platform=Win32`.

`Debug` enables `DEBUG` and `_DEBUG`, while `Release` enables `NDEBUG`, `/Os`, `FatalCompileWarnings`, and `LinkTimeOptimization`.

`clean=true` invokes destructive `rm -rf`, and `prompt()` gates `build()` and `bootstrap()` unless `--yes` is supplied.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `PREMAKE_HASH` equals `2301e3e23ff3074cb83a5ea6103d68c7ea81dad56b786807c84b0643cddea31b`.
- `getbaseversion()` defaults invalid, empty, or `nil` tags to `"0.0.1"`.
- `gitVersioningCommand` equals `"git describe --tags --dirty --always"`.
- `generate-buildinfo` recognizes `#define GIT_DESCRIBE (.+)%s*$`, `#define VERSION_PRODUCT \"([^\"]*)\"%s*$`, and `#define VERSION_BUILD \"([^\"]*)\"%s*$`.
- `local_offline_mode_requested()` recognizes `offline`, `local_offline`, and `local-offline`.
- `has_supported_multiplayer_marker()` requires case-insensitive equality with `"multiplayer"` at RVA `0x0050502C`.
- `xlive.def` ordinal stability and `NONAME` declarations are ABI-critical.
- `offline_xuid()` uses `1469598103934665603ull`, `1099511628211ull`, and `0xE000000000000000ull | (hash & 0x0000FFFFFFFFFFFFull)`.
- `offline_name()` falls back to `"Player"`.
- `title_storage_path()` implements the `offline://<facility>/<sanitized-item>` contract.
- `sanitize_storage_name()` maps empty, `"."`, and `".."` to `"unnamed"`.
- `xlive_XStorageDownloadToMemory()` returns `0x8015C004` for missing files and `0x8015C003` for oversized files.
- `xlive_XNotifyGetNext()` returns `FALSE`, `xlive_XNetGetConnectStatus()` returns connected state `2`, and `xlive_XOnlineGetNatType()` returns open NAT state `1`.

## Installation Constraints

`README.md` requires English/French `1.1`, the default `C:\Program Files (x86)\Activision\Quantum of Solace(TM)\` path, copied release files, and `JB_Launcher_s.exe -multiplayer`.

`README.md` excludes repacks, other regions, unpatched `1.0`, unsupported game versions, and non-multiplayer launches.

`LICENSE` prohibits commercial use, sales, paid software, revenue-generating services, SaaS, and hosting.
